criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: A human being, typically a notable individual.

categories.name: Organization (Educational)
categories.definition: An institution or entity providing education.

categories.name: Organization (Business)
categories.definition: A commercial enterprise or company.

categories.name: Organization (Governmental)
categories.definition: A body or agency of government.

categories.name: Organization (Social)
categories.definition: A club or association formed for social purposes.

categories.name: Literary Work
categories.definition: A written work such as a novel, short story, play, or manga.

categories.name: Film
categories.definition: A motion picture, including documentaries and concert films.

categories.name: Music Album
categories.definition: A collection of musical recordings released together.

categories.name: Publication (Periodical)
categories.definition: A regularly published work such as a journal, newspaper, or magazine.

categories.name: Animal Species
categories.definition: A specific type of animal.

categories.name: Animal Genus
categories.definition: A taxonomic rank above species, grouping related animal species.

categories.name: Plant Species
categories.definition: A specific type of plant.

categories.name: Plant Cultivar
categories.definition: A plant variety produced by selective breeding.

categories.name: Plant Family
categories.definition: A taxonomic rank above genus, grouping related plant genera.

categories.name: Geographical Feature
categories.definition: A natural landform or body of water, such as a mountain, river, lake, or mountain range.

categories.name: Settlement
categories.definition: A populated place such as a village or town.

categories.name: Building (Religious)
categories.definition: A structure used for religious worship or activities.

categories.name: Building (Commercial)
categories.definition: A structure used for business or trade.

categories.name: Building (Residential)
categories.definition: A structure used as a dwelling.

categories.name: Building (Governmental)
categories.definition: A structure used for government administration.

categories.name: Building (Agricultural)
categories.definition: A structure used for farming or agricultural purposes.

categories.name: Building (Educational)
categories.definition: A physical structure used for educational purposes.

categories.name: Building (Historical)
categories.definition: A structure primarily notable for its historical significance, rather than its current function.

categories.name: Infrastructure
categories.definition: A fundamental facility or system serving a country, city, or area, such as a waterworks or dam.

categories.name: Archaeological Site
categories.definition: A place where evidence of past human activity is preserved.

categories.name: Astronomical Feature
categories.definition: A natural formation or object in space.

categories.name: Structure (Monument)
categories.definition: A building or edifice erected to commemorate a person or event.

categories.name: Vehicle Model
categories.definition: A specific model of a car, motorcycle, or other land vehicle.

categories.name: Ship
categories.definition: A large watercraft, including specific vessels and types.

categories.name: Ship Class
categories.definition: A group of ships of a similar design.

categories.name: Aircraft Model
categories.definition: A specific model of an aircraft.
